whyItMatters: a hardcoded PKCS#12 password assigned to PKCS12_PASSWORD kept in version control keeps working for whoever holds a copy of the file until someone rotates it.
actions: Rotate the password in the owning system now.
Search history, images and logs for the same value and purge or invalidate it there.
Store the replacement in a secret manager and reference it by name at deploy time.
verification: The old password no longer authenticates and no literal shaped like this rule remains in the working tree or history.
